claim_boundary.label: preregistered_execution_path_and_failure_neighborhood_ranker
claim_boundary.statement: This contract freezes a preregistered, same-planner held-out-family execution path and a failure-neighborhood ranker. It is NOT a calibrated failure-probability model, and producing this contract generates no new empirical outcome, no proposal-yield claim, no benchmark evidence, and no planner-performance evidence. Any future empirical run is diagnostic/inconclusive until human research-contract review and a powered execution.

design.name: same_planner_held_out_family_transfer
design.description: Fit a failure-neighborhood ranker on the social_force failures of classic_group_crossing_medium; evaluate proposal-vs-random candidate selection on the held-out classic_cross_trap_medium family, using the social_force planner in BOTH arms. Fit and evaluation families are disjoint; the held-out family's archived goal-planner failures are excluded from every fit-side decision.

source_lineage.pre_correction_lineage_note: Tracked archive SHA-256 from PR #5905; pre-correction source lineage only, not the final frozen input.
source_lineage.derivation_basis: docs/context/evidence/issue_5305_certified_archive/recertification_issue_6139.json. Final fit IDs/count/hash derive from this file's records, NOT from the #6139 closing comment, which quotes a different SHA-256 (1406ea545cd07b9e2d96154e3ce10d141c7a121e8c8bc1b736c802b99a796a00) and is not the authority here.
source_lineage.recertification_status: all 17 records are unchanged (before_after_status.unchanged = 17), but the corrected eligibility decisions are authoritative: the final nominal fit set excludes the six group-crossing stress_only records without replacement.

fit.entry_ids_sha256_algorithm: sha256 over canonical JSON of the sorted 6 nominally eligible fit archive_ids (separators=',:', sort_keys=True)
fit.fit_set_definition: Only the six corrected nominally eligible classic_group_crossing_medium / social_force failure records from the recertification artifact are fit anchors. The six stress_only / knife_edge records are excluded from the nominal fit set even though they retain candidate-certification lineage; they are not replaced.
fit.model_initialization: FailureArchiveProposalModel is constructed from a FIT-ONLY payload containing exactly these six nominally eligible IDs. The constructor drops every entry whose archive_id is not in this frozen set, so stress_only, excluded, and held-out-family records cannot influence proposal scores or rank order even if the full archive is supplied as input.

exclusions.reason_detail: These five records use the goal planner (not the social_force target planner) and belong to the held-out evaluation family. They are excluded from fitting, candidate selection, threshold setting, feature tuning, and result interpretation.

evaluation.robot_geometry_source: Frozen centres (in metres at cells_per_meter=2.0) of classic_crossing.svg's explicit robot_spawn_zone and robot_goal_zone; this geometry is a scenario-definition input, not inferred from excluded held-out failures or outcomes.
evaluation.note: Restores the parent #3275 held-out design: evaluate on classic_cross_trap_medium with social_force in both arms. This is NOT classic_group_crossing_medium for both fit and evaluation.

per_feature_semantic_argument.lateral_spawn_m: Signed perpendicular distance from the pedestrian spawn point to the robot's start-to-goal path segment, normalized by the path length. Identical operational meaning in group_crossing and cross_trap: how far off the robot corridor the pedestrian appears.
per_feature_semantic_argument.longitudinal_spawn_fraction: Projection of the pedestrian spawn point onto the robot path as a fraction in [0,1] of path length. Identical meaning in both families: where along the robot route the pedestrian spawns.
per_feature_semantic_argument.lateral_goal_m: Signed perpendicular distance from the pedestrian goal to the robot path, normalized by path length. Same meaning in both families.
per_feature_semantic_argument.longitudinal_goal_fraction: Projection of the pedestrian goal onto the robot path as a fraction of path length. Same meaning in both families.
per_feature_semantic_argument.pedestrian_speed_mps: Pedestrian speed. Inherently family-invariant scalar; identical units and operational meaning in both families.
per_feature_semantic_argument.pedestrian_delay_s: Pedestrian start delay. Inherently family-invariant scalar.
per_feature_semantic_argument.spawn_time_s: Pedestrian spawn time. Inherently family-invariant scalar.

feature_representation.robot_geometry_source: Per-record robot_start/robot_goal come from the corrected recertification reconstruction for fit records, and from the evaluation scenario definition for candidates scored at evaluation time. The transform is a deterministic geometric projection; it does not consume any outcome.

estimand.definition: proposal-minus-random difference in candidate-level certified failure yield under identical candidate budget.
estimand.failure_yield_definition: A candidate counts as a failure only after the predeclared deterministic replay, independent-seed confirmation, and stable-attribution rule all pass for that candidate's execution.

failure_admission.deterministic_replay: exact signature match (replay signature SHA-256 equals original signature SHA-256)
failure_admission.four_of_five_required_note: 4-of-5 is NOT required. The frozen threshold is at least 3 of 5 predeclared independent confirmation seeds, matching the certified archive's confirmation rule.
failure_admission.stable_attribution: primary_failure and termination_reason must be stable across the deterministic replay and the confirming seeds
failure_admission.predeclared_confirmation_seeds_eval: To be fixed by the next sub-issue's evaluation runner using the frozen target_planner social_force; this contract fixes the threshold and rule, not the empirical seeds.

budget.candidate_pool_seed_policy: single shared candidate pool generated deterministically from one predeclared seed; both arms draw from the same pool under identical budget

power_sensitivity.recorded_detectable_boundaries_note: Smallest |proposal_yield - random_yield| for which Fisher's exact two-sided test can reject at alpha=0.05 at the given per-arm budget (boundary of the rejection region; not 80% power, which requires an even larger difference).
power_sensitivity.conclusion: At the frozen budget of 12 candidates per arm, the boundary minimum detectable yield difference is about 0.417, so a minimally important effect of 0.20 is NOT detectable. The frozen budget therefore cannot test the minimally important effect.
power_sensitivity.fit_set_recheck_after_eligibility_exclus: After the six stress_only fit records were excluded, the candidate-level Fisher calculation was rerun at the unchanged k=12 per arm: the 0.417 boundary remains above the 0.20 minimally important effect. The reduced six-anchor fit set therefore does not authorize a powered outcome claim.
power_sensitivity.decision_consequence: When independent outcomes are available but the result is underpowered for the minimally important effect, or the null is not rejected, the decision is inconclusive (never continue/stop on an underpowered signal).

arm_overlap_policy.name: disjoint_by_candidate
arm_overlap_policy.description: Each candidate is identified by one stable shared pool/manifest ID and belongs to exactly one arm. The ranked ID list must be a unique full permutation of that pool. The proposal arm selects its top-k IDs; the random arm selects k IDs from the remaining pool after those exact IDs are removed. A candidate is never counted in both arms, eliminating pseudoreplication. This single deterministic policy replaces any deduplicate_or_disjoint heuristic.

fail_closed_conditions: missing external frozen candidate-manifest binding (ID-to-SHA-256, exact arm membership, and execution seeds)
arm membership or frozen per-arm candidate count differs from the predeclared manifest binding
execution_seed differs from the predeclared manifest seed lineage
execution_mode is fallback or degraded (or not native)
candidate_certification_status != passed (deterministic replay + 3-of-5 confirmation + stable attribution)

diagnostic_namespace.rule: Archive-nearness is the ranking signal only. It is recorded under an explicitly diagnostic namespace and can never drive the top-level comparison, the #2921 stop rule, or the continue/stop/inconclusive decision. Only independent native planner-execution outcomes admitted under the v2 row contract can drive a verdict.

decision_rule.continue: independent outcomes valid AND powered for the minimally important effect AND (proposal_yield - random_yield) >= minimally_important_absolute_yield_improvement AND Fisher-exact two-sided null rejected at alpha=0.05.
decision_rule.stop: independent outcomes valid AND powered for the minimally important effect AND (proposal_yield - random_yield) <= 0 (proposal does not beat random, or random is better).
decision_rule.inconclusive: independent outcomes unavailable, fail-closed, underpowered for the minimally important effect (regardless of outcome sign), or the null is not rejected. Includes any missing/malformed/mismatched/fallback/degraded/lineage-incomplete outcome row.
decision_rule.follows_execution_under_opposite_signs: When archive-nearness and independent execution disagree (either sign), the decision follows independent execution. Both opposite-sign regressions are required tests.
